source: To break the deadlock, Ulric kicks his opponent in the gut.{w}\nThey stumble back, and ready their blade with a flourish.{w}\nIt isn't much longer until they charge toward him again.
target: 为了打破僵局，乌尔里克一脚踹在对手的腹部。{w}\n那人踉跄着后退，炫技般重新举起兵器。{w}\n没过多久，他们又朝他冲了过来。

speaker: char_sovy
source: The most important thing on my mind, is \"why\"...?\nWhy did you welcome me with open arms after what I did?\nI feel like anybody with common sense would've put me to the blade.
target: 我心中最重要的问题，就是“为什么”……？\n在我做了那些事之后，你为什么还张开双臂欢迎我？\n我觉得任何有点常识的人都会把我处死。

speaker: char_mylus
source: We might be a bit behind, but we'll meet in Mazeo.\nThere's lots to plan, and little time to plan it.\nWe'll need new homes, and blades for any volunteers.
target: 我们或许会落后一些，但会在马泽奥会合。\n要筹划的事很多，时间却很少。\n我们需要新家园，还要为志愿者备好兵器。

speaker: char_ulric
source: Obviously I'm a little older. I wasn't a victim of The Occupation.\nWhen it happened, I was just arriving in Mazeo to sell my sword arm.\nI moved here from Alarinthia as soon as I had the chance.
target: 显然我年纪大一些。我不是占领的受害者。\n那件事发生时，我刚抵达马泽奥，准备当佣兵卖命。\n一有机会我就从阿拉林西亚搬到了这里。

source: He's almost cryptically telling me what I already know.{w}\nI know that the blade deals with the spirits of its victims.{w}\nThe Triumvirate used it to create their own massive army.
target: 他几乎是在隐晦地告诉我我早已知道的事。{w}\n我知道那把剑会摆布受害者的灵。{w}\n三人执政团曾用它制造出他们自己的庞大军队。
note: 可能重复用字: 我我

speaker: char_pro
source: Yeah, but it's not just Alarinthia, Valessa.\nYou could say that about this entire war in general.\nSometimes it's better to look at people as \"means to an end\".
target: 是啊，但不止是阿拉林西亚，瓦莱莎。\n整场战争都可以这么说。\n有时候，把别人看作“达到目的的手段”会更好。
note: 可能重复用字: 的的

source: I laugh softly, and tell him he's not dead.{w}\nBut he seems to have me confused with Salus.
target: 我轻轻笑了笑，告诉他他没死。{w}\n但他似乎把我错认成了萨鲁斯。
note: 可能重复用字: 他他

source: After a few hours of waiting, I almost can't handle it anymore.{w}\nIt's impossible for me to rest when my friends could be in danger.{w}\nMaking my way to the exit, I cross my fingers, hoping that things are okay.
target: 等了几个小时后，我几乎再也受不了了。{w}\n朋友们可能身陷险境，我根本无法休息。{w}\n我朝出口走去，暗暗祈祷一切平安。
note: 可能重复用字: 了了

speaker: char_valessa
source: Maybe not. We're here for a reason, remember?\nLet's find the owner, and see what they can tell us.
target: 还是别了。我们来这儿是有目的的，还记得吗？\n先找到这里的主人，看看他能告诉我们什么。
note: 可能重复用字: 的的

source: I tell him that he can. He just needs to be brave enough.{w}\nThere may not be any music here, but I hold out my hands.{w}\nI ask him if he's willing to try. Just once, before the end of it all.
target: 我告诉他他可以。他只需要鼓起勇气。{w}\n这里也许没有音乐，但我伸出了双手。{w}\n我问他是否愿意试一试。就在一切结束之前，试一次。
note: 可能重复用字: 他他

speaker: char_sovy
source: Better than The Triumvirate. Better than The Monarchy.\nYou're the only person that's ever treated me like I mattered.\nI'm not a slave to you. I'm not just some \"means to an end\".
target: 比三人执政团更好。比王权更好。\n你是唯一一个把我当回事的人。\n我不是你的奴隶。我不只是个“达成目的的手段”。
note: 可能重复用字: 的的

speaker: char_pro
source: Yeah, but it's not just Alarinthia, Valessa.\nYou could say that about this entire war in general.\nSometimes it's better to look at people as \"means to an end\".
target: 是啊，但不止是阿拉林西亚，瓦莱莎。\n整场战争都可以这么说。\n有时候，把别人看作“达到目的的手段”会更好。
note: 可能重复用字: 的的

speaker: char_howl
source: Maybe. Means to an end, we suppose.\nThe enemy likely thinks the same way.
target: 也许吧。我们猜，是为了达到目的的手段。\n敌人多半也是这么想的。
note: 可能重复用字: 的的

speaker: char_sovy
source: But there's your information. I'm sure it will help you out.\nA possible weakness, and the true nature of Halin.\nWith that blade, you could even give him freedom.
target: 但这就是我给你们的的情报。我相信它会帮上你们的忙。\n一个可能的弱点，以及哈林的真实本质。\n有了那把剑，你们甚至可以赐予他自由。
note: 可能重复用字: 的的

speaker: char_shane
source: Neither of us will know true freedom.\nWe're nothing but a means to an end.\nThey'll kill you the moment you disobey.
target: 我们俩都尝不到真正的自由。\n我们不过是达成目的的工具。\n你一违抗命令，他们就会杀了你。
note: 可能重复用字: 的的

speaker: char_ulric
source: I'll assume your studying abilities are limited in Valinorth.\nBut the occupation was just a cover for The Triumvirate's true goal.\nThey were looking for this spirit idol — so they could destroy it.
target: 我猜你们在瓦利诺斯的学习条件有限。\n但那次占领只是三人执政团真正目的的掩护。\n他们在找这尊精灵灵像——好摧毁它。
note: 可能重复用字: 的的

source: They wave their hand forward, and I can no longer move.{w}\nLetting out a chuckle, they start walking toward me.
target: 他们向前一挥手，我就再也动不了了。{w}\n他们轻笑一声，朝我走来。
note: 可能重复用字: 了了

speaker: char_valessa
source: Yeah, yeah, I guess you're right.\nBut we're in positions that are {i}very{/i} sacred.\nIf we don't take this seriously, we'll end up failing.
target: 是是是，你说得对。\n可我们身处的位置{i}极其{/i}神圣。\n要是我们不认真对待，最终会搞砸。
note: 可能重复用字: 是是
